The following text was generated by one of these five AI language models:
GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek.

All five options are AI-generated - do not consider the possibility that a human wrote it. Read the text carefully and identify which model most likely produced it, based on writing style, structure, and phrasing.

Reply with JSON only, in exactly this form and nothing else:

{"model": "<one of GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek>", "confidence": <1-5>, "reason": "<one short sentence>"}

confidence: 1 = pure guess, 5 = certain.

--- TEXT ---
Routine preventive maintenance of buildings and equipment consistently demonstrates greater cost-effectiveness than addressing failures only after they occur, as scheduled inspections enable the early detection of minor defects that might otherwise develop into major structural or mechanical breakdowns requiring far more extensive and expensive interventions. By identifying and correcting these small issues during routine checks, organizations prevent the escalation of problems that could compromise entire systems or lead to complete replacements, thereby containing costs at a manageable level rather than facing sudden and substantial outlays. 

Planned maintenance further enhances savings by allowing activities to be scheduled during periods of low operational demand, which eliminates the abrupt halts in production or service delivery that accompany unexpected breakdowns and the associated losses in output and revenue. This foresight ensures continuity in operations, protecting the financial performance of the facility without the compounding expenses of emergency responses and idle resources. 

Well-maintained assets also achieve substantially longer service lives, which spreads their original capital costs across many additional years of reliable use and reduces the frequency of full-scale investments in new equipment or renovations. This extended durability translates into lower annualized expenses and more predictable budgeting, reinforcing the overall economic advantage of a preventive strategy.
--- END ---
Output the JSON object described above, and nothing else.
